mechanism: Spironolactone (potassium-sparing diuretic) combined with torsemide (loop diuretic) increases risk of hyperkalemia and electrolyte imbalances; torsemide-induced hypokalemia may be partially offset by spironolactone's potassium retention, but requires careful monitoring.
action: Monitor serum potassium levels and renal function regularly; assess for signs of hyperkalemia; adjust doses based on electrolyte panel results and clinical response.
